title: Sequential Bitwise XOR Optimization
description:
You are given a sorted array of n non-negative integers and an integer maximumBit. You must perform n queries. In each query, find a value k < 2^maximumBit that maximizes the bitwise XOR sum of all elements currently in the array with k. After each query, the last element of the current array is removed.

Example 1
Input: nums = [0,1,1,3], maxBit = 2
Output: [0,3,2,3]

Example 2
Input: nums = [2,3,4,7], maxBit = 3
Output: [5,2,6,5]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the size of the array.
The second line contains n space-separated integers in ascending order.
The third line contains an integer maxBit.
output_format: Print n space-separated integers representing the optimal k for each sequential query.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
1 <= maxBit <= 20
0 <= nums[i] < 2^maxBit
nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
